knownGaps: No fix has been implemented, so the program's own success criteria are all unmet by definition. The 14 failed assertions recorded above are the baseline, not a regression.

F14 (cross-tenant role reads return 500) is recorded but not scheduled to a wave: it is a response-code quality issue with no data exposure, and folding it into W1 would mix an error-mapping change into the isolation change set.

The two-tenant probe creates and deletes a tenant per run. Re-running it on a shared database leaves archived tenants behind; the cleanup script archives rather than deletes so the evidence rows stay inspectable.
The frontend gates (smoke suite) were not run in this planning step; they are W5's first gate.
